watch.summary: The creator sets up a clutch assist in Rocket League and pops off, standing up in hype celebration.

beats.what: Creator drives ball along the wall toward opponent's goal.
Creator leaps out of his chair shouting in excitement.
Creator sits back down, continuing to hype up the play.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Put it in! Come on! That's the pass!
watch.why: This is a hype gameplay clip rather than a comedy moment, driven by the streamer's energetic standing celebration after making a good pass. It lacks setup/payoff comedic subversion, relying purely on high excitement.
